description: Na₂Ti₉O₁₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.76 Å. There are five inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.32 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-41°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.17 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 28°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.15 Å. In the fourth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-39°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.31 Å. In the fifth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-41°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.04 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OTi₄ trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OTi₄ trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Ti atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Ti atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Ti atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two Ti atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Ti atoms.
